meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, language-native tooling, and optionally CodeGraph knowledge graph. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动审计代码库技术债，生成带修复优先级的报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在清理代码库、规划重构或提升代码质量
copy.tagline_en: Automatically audit technical debt and generate prioritized fix reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are cleaning up codebase, planning refactoring, or improving code quality

howto.what: 装上后，当你要求做代码健康检查或技术债审计时，Claude 会扫描代码，按 9 个维度找出问题，生成 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md 报告，包含每个问题的文件位置、严重级别、预估修复工时和建议修复顺序。
howto.when: 当你说出“tech debt”“code health”等关键词，或要求做代码库健康检查、技术债审计、架构评审等任务时触发。

say.text: 对当前仓库做一次技术债审计，并生成报告。
检查代码健康度，列出最需要优先修复的问题。
say.note: 报告会按严重度排序并附工时估算。

say.text: 重点审计错误处理和安全性这两个维度。
say.note: 只报告这两类的发现，带文件位置引用。

howto.what_en: After installation, when asked for a codebase health check or tech debt audit, Claude scans the code across 9 dimensions and produces a TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md report with file locations, severity, estimated effort hours, and recommended fix order.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say keywords like "tech debt" or "code health", or ask for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, etc.

say_en.text: Run a tech debt audit on this repo and produce a report.
say_en.note: Claude scans the code and outputs TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md.

say_en.text: Check code health and list the top priority fixes.
say_en.note: The report sorts by severity and includes effort estimates.

say_en.text: Focus the audit on error handling and security.
say_en.note: Only these two dimensions, with file references.
